content.title: Academics - Pennsylvania Institute of Technology
content.text: Superior Academics P.I.T.’s academic programs are taught in small, highly personalized classes, led by faculty who are active professionals in their fields. Students can choose from a range of Associate Degree and Certificate options — all distinguished by an active, hands-on learning approach. Whether you’re enhancing your current job skills, changing or starting a career, or planning to transfer to pursue a bachelor’s degree, our career-relevant programs will prepare you for success. Accreditation P.I.T. is accredited by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education, enabling you to easily transfer credits to a four-year college or university to complete a bachelor’s degree. Associate Programs Acquire the specialized knowledge and professional skills needed to begin a successful career in a highly rewarding field. EXPLORE PROGRAMS Bachelor Programs Acquire the specialized knowledge and professional skills needed to begin a successful career in a highly rewarding field. EXPLORE PROGRAMS Certificate Programs In less than one year, earn the skills and credentials required to begin an in-demand career. EXPLORE PROGRAMS Online and Blended Learning In-ClassIn these face-to-face courses you’ll meet with your professor and other students in a physical, traditional classroom. All programs are offered in-class. VIEW PROGRAMS OnlineA virtual classroom setting allows you to complete your course requirements at your convenience with 24/7 access. VIEW PROGRAMS Hybrid (Blended)Hybrid, or blended learning, courses combine traditional classroom instruction with the benefits of more flexible scheduling. VIEW PROGRAMS We want to get to know you! Using the Request Information Tool, you can begin to create your Student Profile! Our Admissions Team is waiting to hear from you and assist you throughout the admissions process. The time is NOW! Discover what awaits you!
